searchText: RE: Attestations. One detail I don't quite get: What is your vote for FFG target when you are at epoch 0? i would follow this: https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/validator.md#ffg-vote in which case, the `source` is a `Checkpoint()` and the `target` is `Checkpoint(epoch=GENESIS_EPOCH, root=GENESIS_ROOT)` `GENESIS_ROOT` is the root of the genesis block Yeah, not the 0x0 stub that starts there so the FFG vote in the first epoch doesn't really provide much value to the chain it's a warm up where would there be a `0x0` stub? <@!291925846556540928> ? **dannyryan** The initial roots store in finalized checkpoint and justified checkpoints are 0x0 In epoch 1, then, I would pick as source the genesis block, and as target, the boundary at epoch 0. Right. I was confused at the votes at epoch 0. I just set both source and target as genesis. Correct? <@!291925846556540928> sure but i *am* saying that the `source` has a `0x0` root bc that is what is in the genesis state am i misunderstanding? If you strictly follow the instructions in the v-guide, it'll give you what you need so during epoch 0: `source = latest_justified_checkpoint` -- which at the start of the chain as `epoch == 0` and `root == 0x00` `target = Checkpoint(epoch=get_current_epoch(head_state), root=epoch_boundary_block_root)` so `epoch == 0` and `root = hash_tree_root(genesis_block)` . whereas in epoch 1, the justified checkpoint might be updated with the _real_ root of epoch 0 (as opposed to `0x00`) but still you just follow the instructions and it'll work out . and yes, essentially at genesis epoch, you are pointing source and target to the same place. It, in effect, does nothing wrt justified/fnialized checkpoints, but the attestations in genesis epoch are important to GHOST/forkchoice so we just cast the full votes regardless What is the v-guide? 😬 There's a spec document covering honest validator behavior Welcome to the discord <@!487955143460126760> ! You have been missed Can’t believe I was only a member of the general channel bridge... and I thought everybody was super silent 😂 You actually have two discord accounts, the other in this server seems unused: <@601455098735886357>

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
If you strictly follow the instructions in the v-guide, it'll give you what you need

so during epoch 0:

`source = latest_justified_checkpoint` -- which at the start of the chain as `epoch == 0` and `root == 0x00`

`target = Checkpoint(epoch=get_current_epoch(head_state), root=epoch_boundary_block_root)` so `epoch == 0` and `root = hash_tree_root(genesis_block)`

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
.
whereas in epoch 1, the justified checkpoint might be updated with the _real_ root of epoch 0 (as opposed to `0x00`) but still you just follow the instructions and it'll work out

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
.
and yes, essentially at genesis epoch, you are pointing source and target to the same place. It, in effect, does nothing wrt justified/fnialized checkpoints, but the attestations in genesis epoch are important to GHOST/forkchoice

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: so we just cast the full votes regardless
